name: Shiki Linen
description: Shiki Linen — a WooCommerce store theme for a small bed-linen shop. A pure white gallery ground under a centred header, three equal framed film-grain photographs, an opposite-edge staircase of bare photographs with moss spec tags, a contiguous six-tone wash-gradation strip, a spec catalogue on a flax band, a parallax washroom photograph and one running-stitch thread that ends in a needle-eye ring. Manrope in weight 200 for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
